judgment.rationale: The manifest matches the rubric. A-1001 is 2.5 lb on UPS at 5.95 against 7.95, saving 2.00. B-5005 is 250 lb on Freight at 150 against 225, saving 75. C-2001 is 50 lb on Fed Ex at 75 against 79.99, saving 4.99. The formulas produce totals of 230.95 cost, 312.94 benchmark and 81.99 savings. All nine columns are kept and tracking numbers are blank, not invented. The submission follows the registry, which marks record-17 (rev 2, USD 150) as approved and in force and record-22 (rev 3, USD 110) as an unapproved draft. It states this conflict and its resolution. It also states the unresolved assumptions: unconfirmed ship date, no carrier quotes for comparison, customer pass-through, and rate-band boundary gaps. The only formatting quirk is the missing 'Date ____' header, which the submission replaces with a note that the shipment date is unconfirmed. This is acceptable because no date was supplied.
